headline: Activists Plan to Dox Elon Musk, Billionaires
summary: An international group claims to have amassed dossiers on hundreds of billionaires, with plans to release personal information starting this month.
details: An underground activist group, calling themselves Capytistas, has announced plans to begin doxing billionaires as part of a campaign against perceived oligarchy. Their initial release is set to include the home addresses of Elon Musk, his brother Kimbal, and Tesla’s board members, along with investors and suppliers.

The group, which includes activists, researchers, journalists, and artists, claims to have spent a year compiling extensive dossiers using various investigative methods. They state they have raised over $1.2 million from individuals who believe extreme wealth and political power pose an existential threat.

The Capytistas intend to publish more than 150 home addresses in upcoming releases, many of which they claim are previously unreported. They also plan to release over 3,500 records on individuals with a combined wealth of approximately $1.4 trillion, detailing alleged criminal exploits and security lapses.

The group's name is a nod to the Zapatistas, and their avatar is the capybara, chosen in contrast to Musk's use of the Doge meme for his 'Department of Government Efficiency'. The term 'oligarch' has seen increased use in American political discourse, with President Biden warning of an emerging oligarchy.

Doxing has become a prevalent tactic, with similar actions targeting individuals and organizations in various political contexts. The Capytistas acknowledge their strategy is doxing and have adopted a creed stating, 'Democracy is not dying, it’s being killed, and those who are killing it have names and addresses.'
